label: Diagram 12.1
caption: Diagram 12.1 Limitations on spacing and size of plastic rooflights that have a class D-s3, d2 or TP(b) lower surface
description: This schematic diagram is titled "Diagram 12.1 Limitations on spacing and size of plastic rooflights that have a class D-s3, d2 or TP(b) lower surface" in a green banner at the bottom. Top left, text reads "See paras 12.5 and 12.6". The drawing itself, on the left, shows two identical double-bordered rectangles arranged one above the other. Each is labelled "Rooflight*" and "max. area 5m²". A vertical double-headed green arrow joins the two rectangles, labelled "3m minimum between any two rooflights in any direction". To the right, an asterisk note states "* Or group of rooflights amounting to no more than 5m²". Below this, a heading "NOTES:" introduces three numbered points. Note 1 reads "There are restrictions on the use of plastic rooflights in the guidance to requirement B2 in Section 4." Note 2 reads "Surrounding roof covering to be a material of class A2-s3, d3 or better for at least 3m distance." Note 3 reads "Where Diagram 5.2a or 5.2b applies, rooflights should be at least 1500mm from the compartment wall."
